bio_en: Satenik Ohanjanian, sister of Dr Hamazasp (Hamo) Ohanjanian, had worked for others from Constantinople and Bulgaria to Tiflis. When the 1915 catastrophe struck she went to Etchmiadzin, the centre of the refugee crisis, to work beside her brother, nursing the most serious cases. She contracted typhus there and died in 1915. Mikayel Varandian's eulogy in Horizon presented her as a model of the Armenian woman's public role.
